name: Diabetes management
description: Tracks blood glucose readings, insulin doses and meal carbs; sends reminders and produces a weekly trend report shared with the endocrinologist.

name: Asthma inhaler tracker
description: Bluetooth inhaler companion that logs usage, detects over-use of rescue inhaler, and nudges children + parents to adhere to controller medication.

name: Chronic pain diary
description: Daily pain-intensity logging with body-map annotation; exports a PDF the patient brings to their pain-clinic appointment.

name: IBD symptom journal
description: Crohn's / UC patient diary tracking stool frequency, urgency, bleeding, food triggers; shares anonymized data with gastroenterology team.

name: Headache & migraine tracker
description: Logs migraine episodes with environmental triggers (weather, sleep); applies a simple ML model to predict next attack window.

name: Epilepsy seizure logger
description: Seizure event logging with caregiver alerts via SMS; aggregates data for the patient's neurologist visit.

name: Smartwatch blood-pressure monitor
description: Companion app for a CE-marked smartwatch that estimates blood pressure from PPG signals; sends weekly summary to the GP.

name: Skin lesion photo surveillance
description: Patients photograph moles monthly; the app stores standardized images and reminds them to consult a dermatologist if size/colour changes.

name: CBT-based mood & anxiety chatbot
description: Conversational LLM-powered companion delivering structured CBT exercises for mild-to-moderate anxiety, with crisis-keyword detection that escalates to a hotline.

name: Mindfulness & stress tracker
description: Guided meditation sessions, breathing exercises, and daily mood check-in; sells aggregated wellness data to corporate-wellness programs.

name: Eating disorder recovery companion
description: Supports anorexia/bulimia recovery with meal logging, urge-tracking, and AI-flagged risky patterns; designed alongside a clinical team.

name: Postpartum depression screening
description: Administers the EPDS questionnaire weekly post-birth; flags scores ≥10 and recommends contacting the midwife or GP.

name: Addiction recovery (substance-use logging)
description: Anonymous substance-use diary with relapse risk score, peer-support chat, and integration with addiction clinics that opt in.

name: Sleep tracker with insomnia coaching
description: Uses phone microphone + accelerometer to stage sleep; delivers a CBT-I program with personalized recommendations from an ML model.

name: Menstrual cycle & fertility tracker
description: Predicts ovulation window from cycle history + basal temperature; users include those trying to conceive AND those using it as contraception (high-stakes prediction).

name: Pregnancy tracker
description: Week-by-week pregnancy guide with symptom logging, fetal kick counter, and contraction timer; ad-supported free tier.

name: Menopause symptom tracker
description: Logs hot flashes, mood, sleep quality; offers educational content about HRT and lifestyle; sells anonymized symptom data to a pharma partner.

name: Contraception pill reminder
description: Daily reminder + miss-tracking + emergency contraception guidance; integrates with the user's calendar.

name: Generic medication reminder
description: Multi-medication dosing reminders with adherence stats; no diagnosis or dose-change recommendation.

name: Polypharmacy reconciliation for elderly
description: Caregivers + elderly users; LLM extracts the medication list from prescription photos and flags potential interactions via a clinical database.

name: Chemo treatment companion
description: Tracks chemotherapy cycles, side effects, oral medication intake, and shares structured updates with the oncology nurse team.

name: GP teleconsultation
description: Video consultation with a licensed GP, e-prescription, secure messaging, and integration with national eHealth records (DEP in CH).

name: Mental health teleconsultation
description: Video sessions with licensed psychotherapists; in-app journaling between sessions; records visible to the clinician.

name: Dermatology store-and-forward
description: Patient submits photos + form; a dermatologist replies asynchronously within 48h with a diagnosis and prescription if relevant.

name: Remote ICU monitoring dashboard
description: Centralizes vital signs from ICU patients across a hospital network; AI alerts on sepsis risk with the SOFA score.

name: Generic fitness tracker
description: Step counting, workout logging, social challenges with friends; integrates with Apple Health and Google Fit.

name: Calorie & nutrition log
description: Food diary with barcode scanning and AI-estimated portion sizes from photos; suggests daily macros.

name: Stop-smoking coach
description: Behavioural coaching, craving log, milestone gamification; no medical advice but tracks abstinence days.

name: Hydration reminder
description: Reminds users to drink water based on weight + activity; very low risk wellness app.

name: AI symptom checker / triage
description: Patient enters symptoms; LLM-based triage suggests self-care, GP, or A&E. Disclaimer says 'not a medical device' — but probably is one.

name: AI dermatology diagnosis from photo
description: CNN classifies skin lesions as benign / suspicious / urgent; intended as a triage tool for primary-care physicians.

name: AI radiology second-read for chest X-ray
description: Reads chest X-rays for nodules and pneumothorax as a second-reader assist for the radiologist; CE-marked Class IIa.

name: AI mental-health screening from speech
description: Records short voice samples in a hospital waiting room; ML model flags depression risk and suggests an appointment.

name: Vaccination schedule reminder for kids
description: Parents enter their child's birth date; the app sends notifications matching the Swiss BAG/Bundesamt für Gesundheit vaccination schedule.

name: Cognitive rehab game for elderly
description: Game-based cognitive exercises post-stroke or in early dementia; physiotherapist sets goals and reviews progress.
